rule: This catalog contains typical-configuration locator hints only. Candidate module names identify source worth checking; they do not prove that the current target configuration/version contains the module, that a procedure exists, or that a retained analog is applicable.
coverage_note: The entries preserve reusable DynamicList/query discovery vocabulary learned from an authorized typical-configuration analog corpus. They are intentionally mechanism-oriented and incomplete. Search the actual target configuration first and require exact target/user-authorized source before using any implementation detail.
proof_required_after_locator_match: exact target or user-authorized typical-configuration module source
exact form/module context that owns the DynamicList when behavior depends on the form
exact exported declaration when a callable API is used
nearby implementation and real call site when applicability/side effects remain ambiguous
target version/runtime evidence when configuration differences can affect correctness
